annotations.title: Best split of deductions and Box 3 between fiscal partners

description: For Dutch fiscal partners (married, registered or chosen in the tax return): finds the split of the own-home result (eigenwoningforfait minus mortgage interest), the joint Box 3 income and shared deductions between the two partners that gives the lowest total income tax, and how much it saves against 50/50 and against putting everything with the higher earner. Partners may divide these freely in the tax return (aangifte).

debts.description: Joint Box 3 debts on 1 January. Default 0.

mortgage_interest_annual.description: Deductible mortgage interest per year. Default 0.

partner_a_gross_annual.description: Partner A gross yearly salary in euros (holiday allowance included)

partner_a_pension_annual.description: Partner A own pension contribution per year. Default 0.

partner_a_thirty_percent_ruling.description: Partner A has the 30% ruling. Default false.

partner_b_gross_annual.description: Partner B gross yearly salary in euros (0 if no income)

partner_b_pension_annual.description: Partner B own pension contribution per year. Default 0.

partner_b_thirty_percent_ruling.description: Partner B has the 30% ruling. Default false.

shared_deductions.description: Shared personal deductions above the threshold (gifts, specific healthcare costs). Default 0.

woz_value.description: WOZ value of the shared own home. Default 0 (renting).

name: fiscal_partner_split_netherlands
